mapper.sql: SELECT t.id AS id, t.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, t.title AS title, t.status AS status, t.priority AS priority, t.creator_id AS creatorId, COALESCE( NULLIF(creator.nickname, ''), creator.username ) AS creatorName, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( COALESCE( NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username ) ORDER BY ta.id SEPARATOR '、' ) FROM task_assignee ta LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ta.user_id WHERE ta.task_id = t.id ) AS assigneeNames, t.start_date AS startDate, t.deadline AS deadline, CASE WHEN t.deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.deadline < CURDATE() AND t.status NOT IN ( 'DONE', 'CANCELLED' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue, t.created_time AS createdTime FROM task t INNER JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON creator.id = t.creator_id

WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'IN_REVIEW' AND ( p.owner_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_member tm WHERE tm.team_id = p.team_id AND tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.member_status = 1 AND tm.role_type IN ( 'OWNER', 'ADMIN' ) ) )
AND t.title LIKE CONCAT( '%', #{keyword}, '%' )
ORDER BY CASE t.priority WHEN 'URGENT' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, t.created_time ASC

WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task_assignee ta2 WHERE ta2.task_id = t.id AND ta2.user_id = #{userId} ) AND t.deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.deadline < CURDATE() AND t.status NOT IN ( 'DONE', 'CANCELLED' )
AND t.title LIKE CONCAT( '%', #{keyword}, '%' )
